children: Bread Financial entered into Amendment No. 2 to its Credit Agreement with JPMorgan and other lenders on Sep 03 2026, which continues to govern the company’s $700 million senior unsecured revolving credit facility. The amendment permits the planned merger of Comenity Bank into Comenity Capital Bank as an exception to certain covenants, while leaving other terms unchanged. The company expects no significant impact on its consolidated financials and maintains liquidity and flexibility.
: Amendment to senior unsecured revolving credit facility ($700 million)
: JPMorgan Chase Bank, as Administrative Agent, and other lenders
: Permit Bank Merger under covenants while maintaining liquidity
